# PanePilot v0.8.0

PanePilot 0.8 brings guarded inline Codex revisions to LaTeX and improves project
navigation, printing, and cross-client session discovery.

## Highlights

- Select LaTeX source, describe an edit, and let a hidden project-scoped Codex runner
  apply only that exact range. PanePilot keeps persistent editorial history and
  offers rollback while the applied replacement can still be located safely.
- Work with a simpler writing-chat margin and clearer document-scope labels, keep
  escaped percent signs highlighted correctly, and print the complete displayed PDF
  snapshot as one native macOS print job.
- Resize the project sidebar by pointer or keyboard with a persisted width, and
  discover tagged tmux sessions created by another PanePilot client on the same host
  as well as over SSH.

Inline edits require the Codex CLI to be installed and authenticated on the local or
SSH project machine.

## Download

The attached DMG and ZIP support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains SHA-256 checksums for both downloads. PanePilot has no
automatic update channel; install new versions from this repository.

PanePilot Remote for Android remains available as source under `android/`; this
release does not include a signed Android APK.

Stable latest-release link: [github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest](https://github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest)

## First launch

This desktop build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized. After copying
PanePilot to Applications, Control-click it in Finder, choose **Open**, and confirm
the launch. Do not disable Gatekeeper. Download PanePilot artifacts only from this
GitHub repository.
